policy: Every selected candidate has one hard gate. Partial, ambiguous, metadata-only, or cross-image satisfaction is failure.

gates.observable_gate: One low-energy blue-green biological repair network visibly connects at least three separated wetland or station elements, while at least two fittings show visibly mismatched hand repairs, patches, or reused parts.
gates.pass_condition: Both the distributed connected light network and two distinct communal repair traces are plainly visible in the same image.
gates.fail_condition: A decorative glow without connected infrastructure, or pristine infrastructure without repeated repair traces, fails.

gates.observable_gate: The luminous glass culture vessel actively used in the pour shows at least two clearly visible etched refill or level-history marks and one conspicuous brass-colored repair seam or clasp.
gates.pass_condition: Luminous contents, active use, repeated refill history, and a physical repair feature coexist on the same vessel.
gates.fail_condition: A plain decorative beaker, marks on a different object, or an ambiguous seam fails.

gates.observable_gate: At least three thumb-sized ceramic diagnostic tiles are visibly mounted along one mycelial conduit path, including luminous violet tiles and one distinctly black tile at a visibly damp interruption point.
gates.pass_condition: Tile count, shared conduit placement, contrasting diagnostic state, and wet failure location are all readable from pixels.
gates.fail_condition: Loose ornaments, fewer than three tiles, uniform colors, or no localized damp interruption fails.

gates.observable_gate: A dedicated handoff rack, separate from the active pour, visibly holds at least three sealed luminous culture refill capsules with attached crescent-shaped shift tokens or maintenance tags.
gates.pass_condition: Separate rack, three sealed supplies, luminous culture, and attached transfer markers are all plainly recognizable.
gates.fail_condition: Generic background bottles, unsealed containers, fewer than three capsules, or absent transfer markers fails.
